excerpt.zh: [from.GetName]的波谱信号表明行星上的一种成分富含某种稀有而复杂的碳同素异形体。为了更彻底的分类，需要更仔细的检查。
excerpt.en: Spectroscopy data from [from.GetName] indicates a planetary composition rich in rare and complex carbon allotropes. Closer inspection is required for more thorough categorization.

texts.zh:
在[from.GetName]上发现了丰富的石墨烯矿藏。这种碳的稀有同素异形体仅有一个分子厚，却拥有无与伦比的强度和导电性。

这种高价值的纳米材料在其地表自然形成，主要得益于这颗碳星球上独特大气的化学蒸气沉积。
texts.en:
Abundant deposits of graphene have been found on [from.GetName]. This rare allotrope of carbon is only a single molecule thick but possesses unparalleled strength and conductivity.

The valuable nanomaterial forms naturally on the surface here thanks to chemical vapor deposition inherent to this Carbon World's unusual atmosphere.
